remarks: Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a beautifully renovated three bedroom condo in one of the area's most desirable and well-maintained complexes. This top floor corner unit offers exceptional convenience and an abundance of natural light throughout. The front foyer opens up into the spacious living room w/ sliding doors leading to a private balcony, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The open layout includes a generous dining area with a charming bay window and a well-appointed kitchen with modern white cabinetry. The primary bedroom offers a walk-in closet, while the additional two bedrooms provide flexibility for guests, a home office, or additional living space. There is a full bath as well as a half bath - a rare offering in this complex! Additional features include in-unit laundry, a newer high-efficiency tankless gas heat and hot water system, newer vinyl flooring in the kitchen & dining room + freshly refinished hardwood flooring in the living room & all bedrooms, private basement storage, & two reserved parking spaces right near the unit (#5 & 6). The complex has also undergone significant recent improvements including new siding, fencing, roofing, & beautifully enhanced landscaping with mature trees, offering a peaceful & welcoming environment. Ideally located walking distance to Metro North, vibrant downtown SONO w/ dining & nightlife, SONO Mall, Maritime Aquarium, bus lines, & major transportation options-this rare 3-bedroom condo truly checks every box!
